admission.justification: Trimming after scope exit lets the allocator reclaim pages the request released, and using the finalizer preserves the timing for refusal and error.

applicability: The native dispatch finalizer on glibc after its request scope closes.
conditions: Invoke malloc_trim when the hook is available. Release depends on there being eligible free pages and the hook succeeding.
exclusions: A specific resident-size reduction is outside this contract.
The dashboard has separately controlled periodic diagnostics and trimming.

evidence: bug-r18-item-2-ordinary-results.md, allocator timing and diagnostics, and test_trim_follows_success_refusal_and_error_after_call_scope_exits.
handoff.path: BUG-L18 W2 affected knowledge and initial history

statement: After the call releases its request scope, the tool server returns free glibc allocator pages when malloc_trim is available.
